name: SeroSlop
description: Browser-local AI image scores for ordinary webpages, fully offline after install.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' data: blob:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; worker-src 'self'
